// Package data may import net/http because it fetches the threat data, so that
// import must not be rejected. Launching processes and the request mistakes
// below still must be.
package data

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"os/exec" // want: depguard
)

// ErrNotFound keeps the os/exec import in use.
var ErrNotFound = exec.ErrNotFound

const source = "https://example.com/data"

// Status never closes the response body.
func Status(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, source, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req) // want: bodyclose
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return resp.StatusCode, nil
}

// Fetch makes a request that can't be cancelled.
func Fetch() error {
	resp, err := http.Get(source) // want: noctx
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return resp.Body.Close()
}
